description: Project-authored geographic reference for plotting findspot claims. NOT corpus assertions. Coordinates locate the named site; they do not verify that any bowl was found there. The corpus claim, its source and its locator remain the authority.

tiers.excavation_stratified: Findspot reported with stratigraphic context (area, locus, floor, or threshold). Strongest.
tiers.excavation_reported: Named site reported as an excavation findspot by an excavation report, scholarly edition, or a museum 'Excavated/Findspot' field.
tiers.site_reported: Named site reported as the place of finding, without excavation context.
tiers.acquisition_site: Museum 'Found/Acquired' field naming a site. The field conflates finding with acquisition; this is where the object surfaced, not necessarily where it was found.
tiers.region_only: Country or historic region. Not a point. Plotted as a region, never as a findspot marker.
tiers.unlocated: A named place the project cannot yet locate confidently. Listed, not plotted.

tell_baruda.label: Tell Baruda (Choche)
tell_baruda.note: Veh-Ardashir, in the Ctesiphon complex opposite Seleucia.

velyki_kuchugury.label: Velyki Kuchugury hillfort
velyki_kuchugury.note: Far outside Mesopotamia. An Arabic magic bowl, published 2025. The site lay on the Dnieper and is now under the Kakhovka reservoir; coordinates are approximate.

tell_al_duwayhi.label: Tell al-Duwayhi, Babil, Iraq
tell_al_duwayhi.reason: Named in the source but not confidently located to a point. Within Babil governorate.

kiamiaz.label: Kiamiaz, on the Tigris near Baghdad
kiamiaz.reason: A nineteenth-century transliteration the project has not yet matched to a known site.

khouabir.label: Khouabir, on the Euphrates
khouabir.reason: Pognon's nineteenth-century place name has not yet been matched confidently to modern coordinates; do not infer a point from the broad Euphrates description.
